patch_design_notes.version_pin_value: 0.9.21 — npm registry dist-tag `latest` (confirmed via direct curl of registry.npmjs.org/@agentmemory/mcp/latest 2026-05-22). NOT `@latest` (D6 today-release-auto-upgrade risk); NOT `0.9.20` (deepwiki cache stale by 1 release).
patch_design_notes.package_choice_mcp_vs_agentmemory: Selected @agentmemory/mcp (thin shim, 13.5 KB unpacked, 4 files) per W286 P0C cardinal-rule-2 contract favoring minimal npx-spawned surface. Alternative `@agentmemory/agentmemory mcp` subcommand is also canonical per README but pulls in the full 5 MB agentmemory package — undesirable per CR-2/CR-9 'minimal spawn surface' discipline. Shim auto-routes to the main package via `~0.9.0` dep.
patch_design_notes.transport_type: stdio — agentmemory MCP is a Node CLI shim spawned by CC per-session, not a remote HTTP service (the agentmemory SERVER on :3111 is started SEPARATELY by the operator if they want the full memory-server + viewer; the MCP shim talks to it via REST if available, else falls back to local InMemoryKV per v0.9.0 changelog).
patch_design_notes.env_interp_pattern: Follows W317-S7 perplexity precedent + W265 langfuse precedent + W286 P0C CR-2 contract: env-interp ${AGENTMEMORY_URL} + ${AGENTMEMORY_SECRET} in tracked .mcp.json, real values held in CLAUDE.local.md (gitignored). If AGENTMEMORY_URL is unset, the shim falls back to http://localhost:3111 default (operator must start `npx @agentmemory/agentmemory` in a separate terminal to back the MCP with live storage).
patch_design_notes.alt_full_plugin_form_not_proposed: Alternative install-shape: /plugin marketplace add rohitg00/agentmemory + /plugin install agentmemory. This bundles 12 lifecycle hooks + 4 skills (/recall /remember /session-history /forget) + 51 MCP tools + auto-wires .mcp.json. NOT proposed in this MCP-wire patch because: (a) it mutates more state (plugin install + hook registration + skill registration) than a single .mcp.json key add — exceeds 'minimal blast-radius' contract for a first-time install; (b) cardinal-rule-4 'auto-fire prompt' audit would need to verify each of the 12 hooks against CR-2 contract; (c) operator may prefer to start with MCP-only and graduate to full-plugin if value is proven.

caveats: C1 (RAPID-ITERATION): v0.9.0 (2026-04-18) -> v0.9.21 (2026-05-19) = 22 minor releases in 5 weeks. CR-9 strict pin to immutable version 0.9.21 (NOT @latest) is REQUIRED. Re-evaluate pin every 7 days OR when operator wants to adopt a new feature; never silent-upgrade.

C2 (SOLO-MAINTAINER): TIER-3-NAMED-INDIVIDUAL bus-factor — single npm publisher (rohitghumare / Rohit Ghumare). No co-maintainer fallback if pkg compromised or maintainer disappears. Mitigation: rely on SLSA provenance + npm package signature for tamper-detection + audit before each pin-bump.

C3 (DEPENDENCY-BLAST-RADIUS): @agentmemory/agentmemory transitively depends on `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@^0.3.142` + `@anthropic-ai/sdk@^0.39.0` + `iii-sdk@^0.11.2` + optionalDependencies on `@node-rs/jieba` + `@xenova/transformers` + `onnxruntime-{node,web}` + `tiny-segmenter`. The iii-sdk transitive dep is LESS-KNOWN and bears the highest unknown-supply-chain risk per Stream B finding. Mitigation: socket.dev/snyk audit before apply.

C4 (STORAGE-OPACITY): agentmemory storage is local SQLite + iii-engine — opaque to humans (unlike T6 basic-memory's markdown). Memory contents are NOT human-readable without using the agentmemory viewer at http://localhost:3113 OR querying via MCP tools. This is by design (BM25/Vector/KG primitives need binary indices), but operator should understand the 'opaque memory store' trade-off vs basic-memory's transparency.

C5 (BENCHMARK-SELF-REPORT): The 95.2% R@5 on LongMemEval-S (ICLR 2025) claim is repo-self-reported per dev.to article 2026-05-15; NOT independently verified. Treat as a directional positive signal not a proven dominance over mem0/Letta-MemGPT.

C6 (SERVER-SUBPROCESS-DEPENDENCY): The shim falls back to local InMemoryKV if the agentmemory server on :3111 is NOT running. For useful persistence, operator must run `npx @agentmemory/agentmemory` in a separate terminal (or set up as a service). This is a 2-process model — the MCP shim talks to the standalone server via REST. Operator may want to NSSM-supervise the server on Windows (similar to CogneeMCP service pattern).

blast_radius_estimate.details: Adds 1 new stdio MCP entry (agentmemory). Spawns `npx -y @agentmemory/mcp@0.9.21` per session — npm cache-resolves to a previously-installed copy (or pulls 13.5 KB shim + ~5 MB main package on first run). If server is not running, shim falls back to local InMemoryKV (lossy across CC restarts).
blast_radius_estimate.subprocess_chain: claude session start -> spawn `npx -y @agentmemory/mcp@0.9.21` -> shim probes GET http://localhost:3111/agentmemory/livez -> if 200, route 51 tools through REST; if fail, fall back to local InMemoryKV
blast_radius_estimate.estimated_token_cost_per_session: MEDIUM-HIGH — 51 MCP tools each with description ~150-400 tokens = ~10-20k tokens preload contribution. Higher than Composio's 7 meta-tools. Operator should weigh: agentmemory adds 51 tools but most usage is 5-10 frequent (memory_save, memory_smart_search, memory_sessions, memory_recall, memory_forget). Compensation: agentmemory's MEMORY benefit reduces re-explain-context cost per session.

notes_for_operator: This is a TIER-2 INSTALL-WITH-CAVEAT — the patch is technically clean (SLSA + Apache-2.0 + active maintenance + 1067 tests + 22 npm releases in 5 weeks with no yanks) but the rapid-iteration cadence + solo-maintainer + iii-sdk transitive dep all argue for socket.dev + smoke-test discipline BEFORE apply.

Memory category overlap check: agentmemory's BM25+Vector+KG overlaps the runtime's T2 (memory-MCP sqlite_vec) and T3 (cognee GraphRAG) — operator should DECIDE whether to (a) install agentmemory as a 7th memory tier complementary; (b) install agentmemory AND retire T2 memory-MCP (since agentmemory's BM25+Vector subsumes sqlite_vec); (c) decline and stick with the existing 6-tier stack. The proposed patch supports option (a); options (b) and (c) require additional retirement / decline workflow.

Standalone-server NSSM pattern: Per the CogneeMCP precedent (NSSM service `CogneeMCP` on :8000), operator may want to register `Agentmemory` as an NSSM service for the standalone :3111 server. This is OPTIONAL (the shim falls back to InMemoryKV if server is down) but recommended for persistent multi-session memory.

Re-pin cadence: with 22 releases in 5 weeks, agentmemory is in pre-v1.0 churn. Recommend re-evaluating the pin every 7 days OR every release the operator wants to adopt. The proposed 0.9.21 pin is the latest stable as of 2026-05-22; v0.9.22+ likely landing within the next week.

Alt full-plugin form trade-off: The /plugin marketplace + /plugin install path bundles 12 hooks + 4 skills + 51 MCP tools. Pros: complete UX with /recall /remember /session-history /forget skills wired. Cons: heavier blast-radius + CR-2 audit of all 12 hooks needed. Operator may want to start with MCP-only (this proposal) and graduate to full-plugin in W374+ if value proven.
